newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ng Fung Hong shareholder sells 12 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Ng Fung Hong shareholder sells 12 mln shrs.

text.p: Ng Fung Hong Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholder, Ng Fung Hong (Holdings) Ltd, had sold 12.30 million of the company's shares on Thursday.
It gave no further details on the share sale.
Ng Fung Hong (Holdings) Ltd held about 35 percent of the live and frozen foodstuffs distributor's 1.0 billion issued shares as of June 1996.
The company also confirmed in a statement issued through the stock exchange no price sensitive negotiations were underway and it knew of no reason for the recent rise in its share price.
Ng Fung Hong Ltd shares rose HK$0.40 or 9.88 percent on Thursday. They were down HK$0.10 to HK$4.35 ahead of Friday's close. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
